fields.terrain: flat coastal plain rises to mountains in east; hilly lowland in west
fields.hazards: typhoons, earthquakes, and severe flooding are rare
fields.farm: chicken, eggs, fruits, vegetables, rice, bananas, beans, cucumbers/gherkins, pineapples, beef
fields.exports: refined petroleum, natural gas, crude petroleum, hydrocarbons, fertilizers
fields.industries: petroleum, petroleum refining, liquefied natural gas, construction, agriculture, aquaculture, transportation
fields.legal: mixed legal system based on English common law and Islamic law
fields.suffrage: 18 years of age for village elections; universal
fields.military: 18-25 years of age for voluntary military service
